name: web-content-pillar-planner-orange-gradient-numbered-list-cards
title: 'Content Ideas' planner with three repeated content-pillar blocks and orange gradient numbered task lists
whatItIs: A white planning template with a bold 'CONTENT IDEAS' title and underline, repeated three times: a pale yellow blank content-pillar card linked by a short connector line to an orange-gradient numbered list (01 Educate, 02 Inspire, 03 Promote, 04 Storytelling, 05 Entertain).
whatItMeans: Practical and repeatable; the same five-item framework applied three times turns strategy into a fill-in-the-blank planning tool.
techniques: Repeat one framework template multiple times for different topics.
Gradient-shade a numbered list from dark to light for visual rhythm.
Leave a blank card for the user's own notes.

vocabulary.definition: A core theme around which content is organised.
A layout with intentionally blank space for user input.
